from.description: Denormalized reference to the parent organization

to.description: Denormalized reference to the child organization

relationship.description: The relationship identifier for this organizational rollup

fromInfo.description: Denormalized type identifier of the parent department role

toInfo.description: Denormalized type identifier of the child department role

involvement.description: Denormalized ownership percentage for hierarchy calculations

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

fromRole.description: The parent {@link Department} in this rollup relationship

toRole.description: The child {@link Department} in this rollup relationship

parent.description: The parent {@link Organization} derived from the parent department

child.description: The child {@link Organization} derived from the child department

ownership.description: The ownership percentage or involvement level in this rollup relationship

title:
Represents a hierarchical rollup relationship between organizational departments.
This relationship type extends {@link PartyRoleRelation} to establish parent-child
relationships within organizational structures, enabling
the modeling of complex organizational hierarchies and reporting structures.
name: OrganizationRollup
